title: Diwali at Times Square 2026
description: The largest Diwali festival outside India returns to Times Square for its 11th edition: a free full day with a Diwali Bazaar, Kids Zone, cultural performances, the Diya Lighting Ceremony and the Light Up Times Square Concert.
long_description:
Diwali at Times Square returns on Saturday, October 24, 2026, for its 11th edition, organised by Sammaan For All and presented by P&G and Tide and Toyota. The free festival takes over Broadway between 46th and 48th Streets in Manhattan.

The day opens with a Diwali Bazaar and a Kids Zone where children can paint diyas, create rangoli art and take Bollywood dance lessons, with vendor sampling and educational stalls through the day. The afternoon brings the 'Colors of India and America' programme, with performances by Indian, Indo-Caribbean and Hispanic dance groups.

In the evening, dignitaries gather for the Diya Lighting Ceremony, with a countdown on the Ball Drop Tower screen, leading into the Light Up Times Square Concert headlined by Kanika Kapoor and Raja Kumari, with Rishi Singh, Shanmukha Priya, Sparsh Shah and Kunal Lamba. Colors TV will broadcast the celebration.

Entry is free and no ticket is required. The festival weekend begins Friday, October 23 with an Awards and Gala Dinner at Tribeca 360 honouring Indian American achievers.
artist_info: Kanika Kapoor, Raja Kumari, Rishi Singh, Shanmukha Priya, Sparsh Shah, Kunal Lamba
